Welcome to Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp
Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp is a luxurious tented camp located within the protected natural reserve of the Serengeti, established in 2023 This exceptional site  enjoys an incredible view overlooking a vast plain that serves as the migration route for wildebeests, offering the opportunity to observe all kinds of wildlife.
The camp is situated 40 km west of Seronera Airport, 2 km from Ikoma Gate, right in the heart of the Serengeti. Positioned along the wildebeest migration axis, it boasts a stunning view of the vast plain.
Spread across 4 hectares, this level of comfort ensures guests can rest well after their safari adventures.

Our Exclusive Accommodation Rooms
The Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp is situated on 4 hectares amidst the savannah. It comprises:
A central area called the “mess” where meals are served and where guests can relax and have a drink throughout the day.
4 individual “Single Bedoom” tents, each with 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
3 individual “Double Bedoom” tents, each with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
3 individual “Triple Bedoom” tents, each with 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.
All rooms are fully furnished and equipped. The bathrooms are comfortable with hot and cold water, a shower, a sink, toilets, a mirror, and a hairdryer. This level of comfort ensures that guests can rest well after their safari adventures.
Single Bed room
Our single rooms provide a serene retreat in the heart of Serengeti. Designed for solo travelers, they combine modern comfort with wilderness immersion. Experience the park’s allure from your private space, while enjoying our exceptional amenities and warm hospitality.

Our double or twin rooms offer a blend of modern comfort and wild authenticity. Perfect for couples or friends, these thoughtfully designed spaces. Experience the magic of the wilderness while enjoying modern amenities in a cozy sanctuary.

Triple Bed room
Our triple rooms in Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp provide spacious and comfortable accommodation for groups or families, allowing up to three guests to share a single room. These rooms combine modern amenities with the untamed spirit of the Serengeti national park.

Restaurant
The restaurant is located at the front of the camp, under a large tent where meals are served. During the day, it transforms into a lounge bar, ideal for relaxing, enjoying a cocktail, and sharing your adventures. Wi-Fi is available to stay in touch with your loved ones. ABOUT US
Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp is a tented camp located within the protected natural reserve of the Serengeti, established in 2023 by Philipo Kimgoni, a safari guide with over 25 years of experience. He utilized his expertise to create this exceptional site with an incredible view.
At the camp, the team consists of about a dozen people dedicated to welcoming you and providing you with a relaxing experience after your Land Cruiser journey through the Serengeti.
They will be attentive to your needs and will do their utmost to make your stay unforgettable despite the logistical challenge of the exceptional location.
Two chefs collaborate to offer you a convivial dining experience, and one person ensures continuous service at the lounge.
At Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp, we don’t merely offer accommodation; we curate an experience that connects you with the soul of the Serengeti. Imagine waking up to the symphony of birdsong and the rustling of leaves as the sunrise paints the sky in hues of orange and pink. Step out of your comfortable tent, designed to blend seamlessly with the environment, and find yourself surrounded by the pristine wilderness that houses some of the planet’s most awe-inspiring creatures. Whether it’s the Great Migration, where thundering herds traverse the plains in search of greener pastures, or the elusive predators that prowl in the shadows, every day brings a new chapter in the captivating story of life on the Serengeti.
OUR FACTS
The Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp offers 20 rooms accommodating solo travelers, families, or groups, providing comfort amidst the wild nature of the Serengeti and beyond. We can also provide you with 4×4 safari vehicles driven by specialized guides fluent in French and English. Our parent company, Kimgoni Tanzania Safaris, offers day trips, multi-day, or multi-week adventures. Our advisors are here to assist you in building the safari of your dreams.

Single Bed room
The Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp offers cozy and comfortable Single Bedroom Tents, providing a serene retreat amidst the breathtaking landscapes of our destination. Each of our Single Bedroom Tents is carefully designed to offer a personalized and intimate experience to couples or solo travelers, or those seeking their own private space.
Equipped with modern amenities and carefully selected furniture, our rooms ensure a restful stay. The rooms feature a large comfortable bed, guaranteeing a peaceful night s sleep after a day of exploration and adventure. The interior decor reflects the local culture while maintaining a touch of elegance and modernity. For couples with a child, an additional bed can be added upon request in the same room.
Natural light streams through well-placed windows, illuminating the space and allowing you to connect with the beauty of the outdoors even when you re inside. You can enjoy views of the surrounding landscapes, immersing yourself in the tranquil ambiance that our camp provides.
Our Single Bedroom Tents also come with a private bathroom offering both convenience and privacy. The bathroom is equipped with essential facilities including a shower, a sink, a large mirror, toilets, ensuring you have everything you need at your fingertips.
Whether you re a couple in need of a peaceful space, or a solo explorer looking to unwind, our Single Bedroom Tents cater to your unique needs. Experience the comfort and tranquility that our camp offers, making your stay memorable and rejuvenating.

Double Bed room
The Glimpse of Africa Tented Camp offers Double Bedroom Tents with two connecting, comfortable, and welcoming rooms that provide a perfect blend of luxury and immersion in nature. These accommodations are specially designed to meet the needs of parents with children as well as couples or friends traveling together. With careful attention to detail and a commitment to quality, we aim to provide you with an unforgettable stay, allowing you to immerse yourself in the beauty of nature without compromising on comfort.
With ample space to accommodate multiple occupants, the Double Bedroom Tents ensure that everyone has their own space. The spacious interior is tastefully decorated, creating a soothing ambiance that complements the surrounding natural beauty. The rooms are equipped with a comfortable queen-sized bed adorned with high-quality sheets and pillows, promising a good night s sleep after your day s adventures. An additional single bed can be added upon request in each room.
The panoramic windows of the room offer breathtaking views of the grandiose savanna landscape, allowing you to wake up to the sounds and sights of nature. The interior layout integrates modern amenities while retaining a rustic charm. You will find practical facilities such as a private bathroom with hot and cold water, a toilet, a sink, and a large mirror, offering the comfort you deserve.
Our priority is your comfort and convenience. Each room has thoughtfully provided storage spaces for your personal belongings, allowing you to keep your living space organized and clutter-free.
The Double Bedroom tents also offers a private outdoor space where you can relax and enjoy the tranquility of the surroundings, whether you re sipping your morning coffee or stargazing in the evening.
